bagPolicy.summary: Wristlets, clutches, or wallets are allowed at all entrances, while purses up to 14''x14''x6'' are permitted at designated X-ray entry points. Backpacks and large totes are not allowed.
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and parenting bags are permitted.

parking.note: Parking options include routes for Platinum pass holders via Oaklawn Exit to Harry Hines Blvd or Tollway to Payne St. General parking access is available via Continental Exit to Victory Ave or Woodall Rodgers Frwy to Field St.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in American Airlines Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The American Airlines Center offers a variety of food and drink options including Slurpees, artisan pretzels, and a range of tacos and nachos. Highlights include signature smashburgers, made-from-scratch pizzas, and a selection of non-alcoholic beverages, beer, and wine. Special offerings include frozen margaritas and cold brew coffee.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Fully ADA compliant. Wheelchair seating on all levels. Accessible parking. Wheelchair escorts free from any entry. Contact: 214-665-4299 or guestservices@americanairlinescenter.com.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: No re-entry once you exit the arena.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Mobile tickets via Ticketmaster are standard. Will call also available. Doors open 90 mins before events.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: North Entrance is the main entry. Accessible entrance with ramps available. Located at 2500 Victory Ave, Dallas.
